functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.create_provably_fair_lottery_round(p_id text, p_title text, p_badge text, p_ticket_price numeric, p_pool_prize numeric, p_draw_time bigint, p_block_target text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_theme text DEFAULT 'cyberpunk'::text, p_banner_image text DEFAULT ''::text, p_min_prize numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_max_prize numeric DEFAULT NULL::numeric, p_winner_share_percent numeric DEFAULT 90, p_winner_count integer DEFAULT 1, p_target_winning_digits text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'extensions', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_server_seed text;
  v_commit_hash text;
  v_client_seed text;
  v_meta jsonb;
  v_meta_str text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_admin() THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Unauthorized: Admin privileges required.');
  END IF;

  -- Generate 256-bit cryptographically secure server seed
  v_server_seed := 'seed_' || encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(32), 'hex');
  
  -- Public commit hash: SHA256 of server_seed
  v_commit_hash := '0x' || encode(extensions.digest(v_server_seed, 'sha256'), 'hex');
  
  -- Initial client seed anchor
  v_client_seed := 'block_' || COALESCE(p_block_target, '#19' || floor(random() * 899999 + 100000)::text);

  -- Assemble metadata
  v_meta := jsonb_build_object(
    'block', COALESCE(p_block_target, '#19,400,000'),
    'theme', p_theme,
    'banner_image', p_banner_image,
    'min_prize', p_min_prize,
    'max_prize', p_max_prize,
    'winner_share_percent', p_winner_share_percent,
    'winner_count', p_winner_count,
    'target_winning_digits', p_target_winning_digits
  );
  v_meta_str := v_meta::text;

  -- Insert event
  INSERT INTO public.lottery_events (
    id,
    title,
    badge,
    ticket_price,
    pool_prize,
    draw_time,
    status,
    winning_digits,
    participants_count,
    tickets_sold,
    sha256_seed,
    block_target,
    server_seed,
    revealed_seed,
    client_seed,
    nonce,
    snapshot_count,
    created_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_id,
    p_title,
    p_badge,
    p_ticket_price,
    p_pool_prize,
    p_draw_time,
    'active',
    NULL,
    0,
    0,
    v_commit_hash,
    v_meta_str,
    v_server_seed,
    NULL,
    v_client_seed,
    p_id,
    0,
    now()
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'event_id', p_id,
    'commit_hash', v_commit_hash,
    'client_seed', v_client_seed,
    'message', 'Provably Fair Lottery Round created with SHA-256 commitment!'
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_game_leaderboard(p_timeframe text DEFAULT 'all'::text, p_metric text DEFAULT 'earnings'::text, p_limit integer DEFAULT 25, p_game_id text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_since timestamptz := NULL;
  v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF p_timeframe = 'today' THEN
    v_since := now() - interval '24 hours';
  ELSIF p_timeframe = 'weekly' THEN
    v_since := now() - interval '7 days';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_agg(sub) INTO v_rows FROM (
    SELECT 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(
        ORDER BY 
          CASE WHEN p_metric = 'multiplier' THEN MAX(gr.multiplier)
               WHEN p_metric = 'wagered' THEN SUM(gr.bet_amount)
               ELSE SUM(gr.net_profit)
          END DESC
      ) AS rank,
      COALESCE(p.username, gr.username, 'Player_' || substring(gr.wallet_address from 3 for 6)) AS username,
      gr.wallet_address AS address,
      COALESCE(vip.current_tier, 'Bronze') AS vip_tier,
      COALESCE(vip.tier_level, 1) AS vip_level,
      ROUND(SUM(gr.payout), 2) AS total_won_fc,
      ROUND(SUM(gr.net_profit), 2) AS total_net_profit,
      ROUND(SUM(gr.bet_amount), 2) AS total_wagered,
      ROUND(MAX(gr.multiplier), 2) AS biggest_mult,
      COUNT(*)::integer AS rounds_count,
      (MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY gr.game_id)) AS fav_game
    FROM public.game_rounds gr
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON p.trc20_address = gr.wallet_address OR (gr.user_id IS NOT NULL AND p.id = gr.user_id)
    LEFT JOIN public.user_vip_progress vip ON vip.wallet_address = gr.wallet_address
    WHERE (v_since IS NULL OR gr.created_at >= v_since)
      AND (p_game_id IS NULL OR gr.game_id = p_game_id)
      AND gr.status = 'settled'
    GROUP BY gr.wallet_address, p.username, gr.username, vip.current_tier, vip.tier_level
    ORDER BY 
      CASE WHEN p_metric = 'multiplier' THEN MAX(gr.multiplier)
           WHEN p_metric = 'wagered' THEN SUM(gr.bet_amount)
           ELSE SUM(gr.net_profit)
      END DESC
    LIMIT p_limit
  ) sub;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_rows, '[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_user_notifications(p_user_address text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_res jsonb;
  v_unread_count integer := 0;
BEGIN
  IF p_user_address IS NULL AND p_user_id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'notifications', '[]'::jsonb, 'unread_count', 0);
  END IF;

  -- Count unread active notifications
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_unread_count
  FROM public.user_notifications
  WHERE is_cleared = false
    AND is_read = false
    AND (
      (p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id = p_user_id)
      OR (p_user_address IS NOT NULL AND wallet_address = p_user_address)
    );

  -- Fetch up to 50 recent uncleared notifications
  SELECT jsonb_agg(
    jsonb_build_object(
      'id', id,
      'title', title,
      'message', message,
      'type', type,
      'action_url', action_url,
      'is_read', is_read,
      'read_at', read_at,
      'created_at', created_at
    ) ORDER BY created_at DESC
  ) INTO v_res
  FROM public.user_notifications
  WHERE is_cleared = false
    AND (
      (p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id = p_user_id)
      OR (p_user_address IS NOT NULL AND wallet_address = p_user_address)
    );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'notifications', COALESCE(v_res, '[]'::jsonb),
    'unread_count', v_unread_count
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_virtual_wallet_leaderboard(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_rows jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_agg(sub) INTO v_rows FROM (
    SELECT 
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY w.balance DESC, w.updated_at DESC) AS rank,
      COALESCE(p.username, 'Player_' || substring(w.address from 3 for 6)) AS username,
      substring(w.address from 1 for 6) || '...' || substring(w.address from length(w.address)-3 for 4) AS address,
      w.address AS raw_address,
      ROUND(w.balance::numeric, 2) AS wallet_balance,
      ROUND(w.balance::numeric, 2) AS usdt_value,
      COALESCE(vip.current_tier, 'Bronze') AS vip_tier,
      COALESCE(vip.tier_level, 1) AS vip_level,
      COALESCE(w.lifetime_won, 0)::numeric AS lifetime_won,
      w.updated_at AS last_active
    FROM public.lottery_wallets w
    LEFT JOIN public.profiles p ON (w.user_id IS NOT NULL AND p.id = w.user_id) OR (p.trc20_address = w.address)
    LEFT JOIN public.user_vip_progress vip ON vip.wallet_address = w.address
    WHERE w.balance > 0
    ORDER BY w.balance DESC, w.updated_at DESC
    LIMIT p_limit
  ) sub;

  RETURN COALESCE(v_rows, '[]'::jsonb);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_username TEXT;
BEGIN
  v_username := COALESCE(
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'username', 
    split_part(new.email, '@', 1)
  );

  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, email, username, role, created_at, updated_at)
  VALUES (
    new.id, 
    new.email, 
    v_username,
    'user',
    NOW(),
    NOW()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE 
  SET 
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    username = COALESCE(public.profiles.username, EXCLUDED.username),
    updated_at = NOW();
    
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

 SET search_path TO 'public', 'auth', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_updated integer := 0;
BEGIN
  UPDATE public.user_notifications
  SET is_read = true, read_at = now()
  WHERE is_read = false
    AND is_cleared = false
    AND (
      (p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND user_id = p_user_id)
      OR (p_user_address IS NOT NULL AND wallet_address = p_user_address)
    );

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_updated = ROW_COUNT;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'updated_count', v_updated);
